name: Zach
source:
You don't know him. Really. You met him once on the street because it was a rainy day, he had no umbrella, and you felt like trying to help a stranger out.

But when Brahms starts acting a little... off. He seemed to have something to do with it. So, who is this guy?

[From [url=https://whatdoinamemyself.itch.io/shrouded-in-your-love]itch.io[/url]]
